system.description:
Gain 2 extra Fears. When either of them makes you Afraid or Terrified, your Speed drops to Slow until you are Stable again.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.79
system.summary: Gain 2 extra Fears. When either of them makes you Afraid or Terrified, your Speed drops to Slow until you are Stable again.

automation.note: Add 2 more Fears to your character.
When one of those 2 Fears makes you Afraid or Terrified, your Speed is Slow (20 ft) until your Fear Status is Stable again. Set it by hand.
